caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a rustic, handcrafted appearance, situated against a plain, light beige background. The chair features four legs and an angled back with three horizontal slats that have an uneven, wavy contour. The wood is rendered in shades of light to medium brown, with visible grain and texture. The seat of the chair appears to be made from a piece of animal hide, colored in darker brown hues, and is loosely draped and fastened to the chair frame. The overall composition is centered, with the chair depicted at a slight angle, giving a clear view of its three-dimensional shape and construction. No additional objects or details are present in the background.
title: Handmade Chair - Rawhide Seat
